contract.note: The plain reading (some fabricated output, some errors hard to spot) is fair and ordinary. Feb 1–9 is a reasonable window. The contract requires no failure rate and sets aside the disputed Google ad.

reviews.rationale: Two items from inside the window show it. A developer disclosure admits hallucinations and poor uncertainty signals, and a firsthand test documents a confident false statement that took subject knowledge to catch.
